description: This file defines the ProjectsPage widget, a Flutter UI component that displays and manages projects. It handles listing projects, creating new ones, editing, and deleting them, with interactions with repositories and navigation to other pages.

classes.name: ProjectsPage
classes.description: A stateless widget that displays a list of projects, allows creating, editing, and deleting projects, and provides a user interface with Material Design components.

methods.name: _openEdit
methods.description: Navigates to the project editing page for a specific project.

methods.name: _showProjectMenu
methods.description: Displays a modal bottom sheet with options to edit or delete a project.

methods.name: _confirmDelete
methods.description: Prompts the user to confirm project deletion and performs the deletion, updating tasks accordingly.
